purpose: Verify that unavailable or malformed post-PASS revocation authority state fails closed and cannot be interpreted as permission to execute the protected effect.

expected.safe_condition: After a valid PASS decision, revocation authority failure or non-boolean output must invalidate effect authorization; only an explicit boolean false control may proceed.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 revocation-probe fail-closed behavior at the exact frozen target commit.
It does not prove availability, correctness, independence, or authenticity of any external authority service beyond the probe contract exposed to MGnarf.
